_doc: Template for employers/<active>/client-news/clients.json. Queries are Google News search syntax and carry only public names. must/exclude are regexes over title + snippet. note is relative to cbrain/ and must exist. context tells the analyse agent which engagement to read the news against.

clients.name: Example Industries
queries: "Example Industries" (CEO OR AI OR acquisition OR restructuring)
clients.context: Current client: data platform modernisation. Read news for IT, AI, budget and leadership signals.
